## Source growth program

Today's Japanese-platform research screened five previously untracked candidate families: 野いちご, ノベマ！, ノベモア, ノベルアップ＋, and pixiv novels.

- **野いちご — PASS, link-only.** Current official discovery exposes search/ranking/genre/review surfaces. Current terms limit the service to personal use and state Japan access/use scope while preserving platform/provider rights. WebNR therefore admits only the official destination plus WebNR-authored metadata; richer automation remains outside the capability.
- **ノベマ！ — PASS, link-only.** Current official discovery exposes genre/ranking surfaces. Current terms reserve site/provider/third-party rights and constrain unpermitted reuse. WebNR stores only a first-party discovery URL and its own description.
- **ノベモア — DEFER automation.** Current July 2026 terms explicitly prohibit automated tools/scraping and preserve author content rights while restricting unapproved reproduction/reuse. No runtime adapter is admitted.
- **ノベルアップ＋ — DEFER.** Current public evidence confirms an active publisher-operated web-fiction service and public reader access, but today's evidence does not establish a complete richer machine-interface/robots/cadence/pagination/provenance/update/deletion/rights contract.
- **pixiv novels — DEFER.** The ecosystem is relevant, but service-wide terms and account/content boundaries require a dedicated current audit before any WebNR admission. Public discoverability does not imply automated access or reuse permission.

The daily target of one passing integration is satisfied by #102, which adds two conservative first-party link-only destinations. Today's rotating maintained-source health sample reused the Japanese starter: Narō, Kakuyomu, and Everystar remain present unchanged in the generated five-record artifact, and no evidence justifies deletion, downgrade, coverage shrinkage, or automated-origin expansion.
